## `list_github_templates`

*Available in [Python](#list_github_templates-python)*
=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Function to list the available CIDAtools GitHub templates.
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    list_github_templates(
        display=True,
        include_empty=True
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `display` (`bool`) - Whether to print the list of templates to the console.
    - `include_empty` (`bool`) - If true, include the option to create an empty repository.

    <h4>Returns `list[TemplateRepo] | None`</h4>

    A list of `TemplateRepo` objects.
